newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Centennial rises on land deal approval.
newsitem.headline: Centennial rises on land deal approval.

text.p: Centennial City Inc gained 35 centavos, or 10.93 percent, by mid-session on Monday to 3.55 pesos on reports the government had upheld the contract entered into by its subsidiary, brokers said.
"Centennial is being given a new lease of life," one trader from a local brokerage house said.

Press secretary Hector Villanueva said on Friday that the contract entered into by the Amari consortium with the state-owned Philippine Estate Authority to undertake a 750-hectare reclamation project was found to be a "sound contract".
The contract was reviewed after Senate President Ernesto Maceda claimed the property was grossly undervalued.
Centennial was the most actively traded issue on Monday with more than 89 million shares traded after an hour of trade.
Besides Centennial, the Amari consortium includes Thai firm Ital-Thai Development Plc and Centennial's parent Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc.
